description: Halloy: open-source IRC client written in Rust with the iced GUI library. IRCv3, SASL, multiple servers, themes and a split-pane layout.
notes: Halloy keeps its config, history (history.sqlite3), logs and themes in %USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\Halloy:
the manifest sets the user environment variable HALLOY_PORTABLE_DIR to that folder.
If Halloy opens with an empty config right after the install, sign out and back in once,
so that Explorer picks up the new variable.
Passwords saved with password_keyring = true live in Windows Credential Manager;
irc://, ircs:// and halloy:// links are not registered: upstream's installer does that, Scoop does not run it.
pre_install: # Upstream's Inno Setup installer (per user by default). With HALLOY_PORTABLE_DIR set, that copy would share this one's data.

error "Halloy $($innoCopy.DisplayVersion) is already installed with upstream's installer ($(($innoCopy.InstallLocation) -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')). Uninstall it first in Settings > Apps; your config and history in %APPDATA%\halloy stay and are copied into Scoop's persist folder on install. Scoop has already downloaded and unpacked ${app}: run 'scoop uninstall $app' or simply install again, which cleans that up."
# A fresh install stops if Halloy is running or its data files are in use (scripts/common/Test-AppBusy.ps1).
# Updates are checked in pre_uninstall, which Scoop runs before it removes the old version.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { error "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$($busyCheck -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')' is missing."; break }
if ($busy) { error "$app is in use. Close it (and anything holding its files open) and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }
# Halloy keeps all config and data in HALLOY_PORTABLE_DIR (see env_set), that is directly in $persist_dir.
# Data that a manifest without HALLOY_PORTABLE_DIR (such as extras/halloy) left in the previous version folder.
# Filter by name: 'Get-ChildItem path\* -Include' would list the contents of subfolders instead of the subfolders.
# Data of a copy from upstream's installer (or of Halloy run without Scoop); left in place.
# No default config here: on its first start Halloy writes its own config.toml with a random halloyNNNN nick.
pre_uninstall: # 'scoop update' and 'scoop uninstall' stop here, before anything is removed, if Halloy is running
# or its data files are in use (scripts/common/Test-AppBusy.ps1).
# Without the helper (e.g. the bucket was removed) only warn: uninstalling must stay possible.
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $busyCheck)) { warn "Cannot check whether $app is in use: '$($busyCheck -replace [regex]::Escape($env:USERPROFILE), '%USERPROFILE%')' is missing."; return }
if ($busy) { error "$app is in use. Close it (and anything holding its files open) and try again:`n  $($busy -join "`n  ")"; break }
